# Sample audio fixtures

These fixtures were self-recorded for Issue #12 using fictional project content. They do not contain private or unauthorized meeting material.

| File | Language | Duration | Format |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `sample-zh.wav` | Chinese (`zh-CN`) | 14.677 s | WAV, 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM |
| `sample-en.wav` | English (`en`) | 16.981 s | WAV, 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM |

## Verbatim transcripts

### `sample-zh.wav`

> 大家好，今天我们讨论 Turnnote 项目的开发进度。当前的主要任务是准备测试音频，并检查语音识别功能是否能够正确处理中文内容。

### `sample-en.wav`

> Hello everyone. Today we are reviewing the development progress of the Turnnote project. Our current task is to prepare sample audio and test whether the speech recognition feature works correctly.

## Validation

Both files were converted from the original self-recorded M4A files and successfully decoded with macOS `afinfo`. Each file is non-empty and falls within the required 10–30 second duration.
